answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. A new agent locks twice its 30-day reward, released only as a fingerprint forms: a pulse of tasks and timing no script repeats. Past work accrues like layers of shale, each checked against earlier layers, so a copied relic credential with no history stays locked. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 deposits and fingerprints; one honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
